worlds.name: Olympus
worlds.blurb: The floating island: Mount Olympus, the Acropolis and Greek buildings for each project.

worlds.name: Cozy Village
worlds.blurb: The same island as a cozy village: timber cottages, the Hilltop Hall and a fox for a messenger.

worlds.name: Golden Hour
worlds.blurb: Always early evening: warm light, cream cards and a gold-trimmed messenger.

worlds.name: Night Watch
worlds.blurb: Always night: calm and ambient, lit windows and lantern-gold labels.

worlds.name: Black-figure Vase
worlds.blurb: The island painted like a Greek vase: black figures on terracotta, meander borders.

worlds.name: Sea Chart
worlds.blurb: A hand-inked map seen from above, on parchment.

worlds.name: Diorama Ops
worlds.blurb: Top-down tilt-shift with a city-builder HUD.

worlds.name: Agora Board
worlds.blurb: The practical one: a card board of what is happening, the island in a porthole beside it.

worlds.name: Oracle's Scroll
worlds.blurb: Dusk, with the day kept on an unrolled scroll.

worlds.name: In Elevation
worlds.blurb: The island side-on, in pastels.

worlds.name: Holo Command
worlds.blurb: The island as a hologram in a control room.

worlds.name: Farmers Market
worlds.blurb: Stalls are projects and vendors are threads; a vendor waving needs you.

worlds.name: Night City
worlds.blurb: Neon towers are projects and the people on the streets are threads, always after dark.

worlds.name: The Office
worlds.blurb: Desk pods are projects and coworkers are threads; the stand-up corner holds the board.

worlds.name: Bus Lines
worlds.blurb: Each project is a stop on a little road; riders are threads and the depot sits on the hill.

worlds.name: Space Station
worlds.blurb: Consoles and bays are projects and the crew are threads, holding orbit at midnight.

worlds.name: Pirate Harbor
worlds.blurb: Ships are projects and sailors are threads; the lighthouse fort keeps watch from the peak.

worlds.name: Theme Park
worlds.blurb: Rides are projects and guests are threads; the Big Top stands on the hill.

worlds.name: Restaurant Kitchen
worlds.blurb: Cooking stations are projects and chefs are threads; orders go up on the ticket rail.

worlds.name: Haunted Cemetery
worlds.blurb: Crypts are projects and ghosts are threads, wandering the hill at night.

worlds.name: Factory Floor
worlds.blurb: Production lines are projects and workers are threads; the control room runs the plant.
